newSignedForm.label: Newly Signed Form
newSignedForm.template: Please submit a newly signed {formName} with updated signatures and dates because {reason}.

completedSignedForm.label: Completed and Signed Form
completedSignedForm.template: Please submit a completed and signed {formName}.

missingForm.label: Missing Form
missingForm.template: Please submit the {formName}, as it was not provided. {additionalDetail}

requiredFormReason.label: Required Form With Reason
requiredFormReason.template: Please submit a completed and signed {formName}. This form is required because {reason}.

correctedForm.label: Corrected Form
correctedForm.template: Please submit a corrected, completed, and signed {formName} reflecting {correctionDetail}.

blankForm.label: Blank Form Submitted
blankForm.template: Please resubmit the {formName}, as the form submitted was blank.

unsignedForm.label: Unsigned Form
unsignedForm.template: Please resubmit the {formName} with the required signatures and dates, as the form submitted was unsigned.

outdatedForm.label: Outdated Form
outdatedForm.template: The {formName} submitted is an outdated version. {acceptanceDetail} Please use the current version of the form moving forward.

unauthorizedDigitalSignature.label: Unauthorized Digital Signature

multipleFormsRequired.label: Multiple Forms Required

newHipaaAuthorization.label: New HIPAA Authorization
newHipaaAuthorization.template: Please submit a newly signed HIPAA Authorization, as the form submitted is {reason}. A HIPAA Authorization cannot be amended, corrected, altered, or contain crossouts.

formSignatureLocation.label: Form Signature Location
formSignatureLocation.template: Please provide the city and state in which the {formName} was signed by the {signer}.

formTimingIssue.label: Form Signature Date or Timing Issue
formTimingIssue.template: Please resubmit the {formName}, as it must be signed and dated {timingRequirement}.

questionNotAnswered.label: Question Not Answered
questionNotAnswered.template: Please provide an answer for question {questionNumber} of the {formName}, as it was not answered.

questionsNotAnswered.label: Multiple Questions Not Answered
questionsNotAnswered.template: Please provide answers for questions {questionNumbers} of the {formName}, as they were not answered.

questionConflict.label: Conflicting Question Responses
questionConflict.template: Please confirm {subject}. Question {questionOne} indicates {answerOne}; however, question {questionTwo} indicates {answerTwo}.

questionCorrection.label: Question Requires Correction
questionCorrection.template: Please update question {questionNumber} of the {formName} to reflect {correctResponse}, and have the appropriate signer initial and date the change.

missingPersonInformation.label: Missing Person Information
missingPersonInformation.template: Please provide the {personType}'s {informationNeeded}, as it was not provided.

signerTitleRequired.label: Entity Signer Title Required
signerTitleRequired.template: Please provide the title of the individual signing on behalf of the {entityName}.

policyDesignMismatch.label: Policy Design Mismatch
policyDesignMismatch.template: {designElement}: The Part 1 indicates {applicationValue}; however, the illustration indicates {illustrationValue}. Please confirm the intended policy design.

multiplePolicyDesignIssues.label: Multiple Policy Design Issues
multiplePolicyDesignIssues.template:
Please confirm the intended policy design for the following items:
{designIssues}

planTypeMissing.label: Plan Type Not Answered
planTypeMissing.template: Please confirm the plan type, as question {questionNumber} of the Part 1 was not answered.

paymentFrequencyInvalid.label: Invalid Payment Frequency
paymentFrequencyInvalid.template: Please confirm the intended payment frequency. The Part 1 indicates {selectedFrequency}; however, that selection is unavailable. The available options are {availableOptions}.

riderIllustrationRequired.label: Rider Illustration Required
riderIllustrationRequired.template: Please submit an unsigned illustration reflecting the selected {riderName}.

beneficiaryMismatch.label: Beneficiary Mismatch
beneficiaryMismatch.template: Please confirm the intended beneficiary designation. The Part 1 indicates {partOneValue}; however, the Beneficiary Designation Form indicates {beneficiaryFormValue}.

beneficiaryRelationship.label: Beneficiary Relationship
beneficiaryRelationship.template: Please provide the relationship of the beneficiary or beneficiaries to the insured.

beneficiaryPercentageMissing.label: Beneficiary Percentage Missing
beneficiaryPercentageMissing.template: Please confirm the beneficiary percentage, as it was not provided.

beneficiaryPercentageInvalid.label: Beneficiary Percentage Invalid
beneficiaryPercentageInvalid.template: Please confirm the intended beneficiary percentage. The form indicates {currentValue}; however, the total beneficiary allocation must equal 100%.

beneficiaryPerStirpes.label: Beneficiary Per Stirpes Confirmation
beneficiaryPerStirpes.template: Please confirm whether the beneficiary designation should include a per stirpes provision.

sourceMismatch.label: Information Mismatch Between Sources
sourceMismatch.template: Please confirm the correct {informationType}. The {firstSource} indicates {firstValue}; however, the {secondSource} indicates {secondValue}.

mvrAddressMismatch.label: MVR Address Mismatch
mvrAddressMismatch.template: Please confirm the client's address, as it does not match the Motor Vehicle Report. Has the client recently moved?

mvrNameMismatch.label: MVR Name Mismatch
mvrNameMismatch.template: Please submit a copy of the client's photo identification, as the client's name does not match the Motor Vehicle Report. Has the client recently changed their name?

mvrDobMismatch.label: MVR Date of Birth Mismatch
mvrDobMismatch.template: Please submit a copy of the client's photo identification, as the date of birth provided on the {formName} does not match the Motor Vehicle Report.

mvrSsnMismatch.label: MVR SSN Mismatch
mvrSsnMismatch.template: Please submit a copy of the client's Social Security card, as the Social Security number provided on the {formName} does not match the Motor Vehicle Report.

nyIllustrationIssue.label: New York Illustration Issue
nyIllustrationIssue.template: Please submit a signed sales illustration matching the Part 1. The illustration submitted is {illustrationIssue}. This is required for New York policies under Regulation 74.

nyIllustrationAtApproval.label: New York Illustration Required at Approval
nyIllustrationAtApproval.template: Please submit a signed sales illustration as applied for. This is required before issue.

unsignedIllustration.label: Unsigned Illustration Required
unsignedIllustration.template: Please submit an unsigned sales illustration {illustrationDetail}.

producerStatementCommission.label: Producer Statement Commission Information
producerStatementCommission.template: Please provide the first-year commission and recurring commission percentages, as this information was not provided on the Producer Statement.

saveAgeSelectionMissing.label: Save Age Questions Not Answered
saveAgeSelectionMissing.template: Please advise whether the policy should be issued at current age or with saved age, as questions {questionNumbers} of the Part 1 were not answered.

saveAgeBothSelected.label: Both Save Age Options Selected
saveAgeBothSelected.template: Please advise whether the policy should be issued at current age or with saved age, as both options were selected in questions {questionNumbers} of the Part 1.

ageChangeConfirmation.label: Age Change Confirmation
ageChangeConfirmation.template: An age change occurred after the application was submitted. Please advise whether the policy should be issued at current age or with saved age.

absoluteAssignment1035.label: 1035 Exchange Absolute Assignment
absoluteAssignment1035.template: Please submit a fully completed Absolute Assignment Form ({formNumber}) for the 1035 exchange. The form must be wet signed. {deliveryDetail}

visaRequired.label: Visa Required
visaRequired.template: Please provide a copy of the insured's visa.

licensingRequirement.label: Licensing Requirement
licensingRequirement.template: Please note that this case currently has an open licensing requirement. Most licensing requirements are resolved before approval; however, if the outstanding requirement affects the signature dates, new paperwork may be required. A follow-up communication will provide the next steps needed to resolve the licensing requirement.
